#Reading in the Data
```{r reading in data and cleaning it}
#expt from 8/29
expt_1_6well <- read.delim("COPAS Data/8_29_24/tca_worms_final_2_1.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names

metadata_expt_1 <- read_xlsx("COPAS Data/8_29_24/metadata_tcaa_08292024.xlsx")

expt_1_cleaned <- expt_1_6well %>%
  select(id, source_well, tof, extinction, ph_extinction, pw_extinction) %>%
  left_join(metadata_expt_1, by = "source_well") %>%
  mutate(dose = factor(dose, levels = c("100 mM", "50 mM", "25 mM", "10 mM", "5 mM", "2.5 mM", "1 mM", "500 uM", "250 uM", "100 uM", "M9", "Untreated"))) %>%
  mutate(norm_ext = extinction/tof) %>%
  mutate(norm_ph_ext = ph_extinction/tof)

expt_1_6well_cleaned_N2 <- expt_1_cleaned %>%
  filter(strain == "N2") %>%
  select(-strain) %>%
  mutate(experiment = "1")

#expt from 8/30
```

```{r combining datasets}
#summary of datasets I have right now
#6 well: expt_1_6well_cleaned_N2
#expt_2_6well_cleaned_N2
#expt_3_multi_6well
#expt_4_multi_6well

#Agar volume: expt_3_multi_agar_volume

all_6_well <- bind_rows(
  expt_1_6well_cleaned_N2 %>% mutate(experiment = "1"),

all_6cm <- bind_rows(
```

#Normalizing the Data pre-filtering and Descriptive Stats
``` {r normalization to the control within each experiment}
# all_6_well
all_6_well_norm <- all_6_well %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(tof[dose == "M9"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent_control = (tof / control_mean) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# all_agar_volume
all_agar_volume_norm <- all_agar_volume %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(tof[treatment == "3 mL agar"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent_control = (tof / control_mean) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# all_liquid_culture
all_liquid_culture_norm <- all_liquid_culture %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(tof[dose == "M9"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent_control = (tof / control_mean) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# all_6cm
all_6cm_norm <- all_6cm %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(tof[dose == "M9"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent_control = (tof / control_mean) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

```

``` {r descriptive statistics for each expt + compiled experiments - no filtering}
desc_stats <- function(df, group_var) {
  df %>%
    group_by(experiment, {{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      count  = n(),
      mean   = mean(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR    = IQR(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# per experiment
stats_6well_per_expt          <- desc_stats(all_6_well_norm, dose)
stats_agar_volume_per_expt    <- desc_stats(all_agar_volume_norm, treatment)
stats_liquid_culture_per_expt <- desc_stats(all_liquid_culture_norm, dose)
stats_6cm_per_expt            <- desc_stats(all_6cm_norm, dose)

# experiments combined
desc_stats_combined <- function(df, group_var) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      count  = n(),
      mean   = mean(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR    = IQR(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

stats_6well_combined          <- desc_stats_combined(all_6_well_norm, dose)
stats_agar_volume_combined    <- desc_stats_combined(all_agar_volume_norm, treatment)
stats_liquid_culture_combined <- desc_stats_combined(all_liquid_culture_norm, dose)
stats_6cm_combined            <- desc_stats_combined(all_6cm_norm, dose)
```

#Filtering the Data
``` {r pca and kmeans clustering}
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)

process_pca_kmeans <- function(dataset, plot_title) {
  dataset <- dataset[complete.cases(dataset[, c("tof", "extinction", "ph_extinction", "pw_extinction", "norm_ext")]), ]
  
  pca_result <- PCA(dataset[, c("tof", "extinction", "ph_extinction", "pw_extinction", "norm_ext")], scale.unit = TRUE)
  
  pca_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_result, geom = "point", 
                           addEllipses = TRUE, title = "PCA of TOF, EXT, PH EXT, PW EXT, and norm.EXT")
  
  pca_data <- pca_result$ind$coord[, 1:2]
  
  set.seed(123)
  kmeans_pca_result <- kmeans(pca_data, centers = 3)
  
  dataset$pca_kmeans_cluster <- kmeans_pca_result$cluster
  
  kmeans_plot <- ggplot(dataset, aes(x = tof, y = extinction, color = factor(pca_kmeans_cluster))) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) + 
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Time of Flight (TOF)", y = "Extinction", color = "Cluster") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#E07B54", "2" = "#4E79A7", "3" = "#6BAF92")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(list(dataset = dataset, pca_plot = pca_plot, kmeans_plot = kmeans_plot))
}

datasets <- list(expt_1_6well_cleaned_N2, expt_2_6well_cleaned_N2, expt_3_multi_6well,
                 expt_4_multi_6well, expt_5_6cm_cleaned_N2, expt_6_6cm_cleaned_N2,
                 expt_3_multi_liquid_culture, expt_4_multi_liquid_culture, 
                 expt_3_multi_agar_volume, expt_4_multi_agar_volume)

plot_titles <- c("Experiment 1 - 6-Well Plate", "Experiment 2 - 6-Well Plate",
                 "Experiment 3 - 6-Well Plate", "Experiment 4 - 6-Well Plate",
                 "Experiment 1 - 6 cm Plate", "Experiment 2 - 6 cm Plate",
                 "Experiment 1 - Liquid Culture", "Experiment 2 - Liquid Culture",
                 "Experiment 1 - Agar Volume", "Experiment 2 - Agar Volume")

set.seed(123)
processed_results <- mapply(process_pca_kmeans, datasets, plot_titles, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

plot_names <- c("clustering_expt_1_6well", "clustering_expt_2_6well", "clustering_expt_3_6well",
                "clustering_expt_4_6well", "clustering_expt_1_6cm", "clustering_expt_2_6cm", 
                "clustering_expt_1_liquid_culture", "clustering_expt_2_liquid_culture", 
                "clustering_expt_1_agar_volume", "clustering_expt_2_agar_volume")

for (i in seq_along(plot_names)) {
  assign(plot_names[i], processed_results[[i]]$kmeans_plot)
}

# view plots in viewer
clustering_expt_1_6well; clustering_expt_2_6well; clustering_expt_3_6well; clustering_expt_4_6well
clustering_expt_1_6cm; clustering_expt_2_6cm
clustering_expt_1_liquid_culture; clustering_expt_2_liquid_culture
```

``` {r post-filtered plots with clusters}
pre_filter_datasets <- lapply(processed_results, `[[`, "dataset")

post_filter_plots <- mapply(function(pre_dataset, post_dataset, title) {
  
  x_min <- min(pre_dataset$tof, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(pre_dataset$tof, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(pre_dataset$extinction, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(pre_dataset$extinction, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(post_dataset, aes(x = tof, y = extinction, color = factor(pca_kmeans_cluster))) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time of Flight (TOF)", y = "Extinction", color = "Cluster") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#E07B54", "2" = "#4E79A7", "3" = "#6BAF92")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max), ylim = c(y_min, y_max)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}, pre_filter_datasets, post_filter_datasets, post_filter_titles, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(post_filter_plot_names)) {
  assign(post_filter_plot_names[i], post_filter_plots[[i]])
}
```

``` {r post-filtered plots}
prism_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

create_plot_ext_vs_tof_per_dose <- function(data, dataset_name) {
  data <- data %>% filter(dose %in% c("100 mM", "10 mM", "1 mM", "M9"))
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = tof, y = extinction)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = paste("Extinction vs TOF - Per Dose (", dataset_name, ")", sep = ""),
         x = "Time of Flight (TOF)",
         y = "Extinction") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    prism_theme +
    facet_wrap(~ dose, scales = "free_x")
}

create_plot_ext_vs_tof_per_dose_alt <- function(data, dataset_name) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = tof, y = extinction)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = paste("Extinction vs TOF - Per Dose (", dataset_name, ")", sep = ""),
         x = "Time of Flight (TOF)",
         y = "Extinction") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    prism_theme +
    facet_wrap(~ treatment, scales = "free_x")
}
```

#Agar Volume Measurements
``` {r ANOVA for agar volume, pre-filter}
# one-way ANOVA
model_agar_volume_1 <- aov(tof ~ treatment, data = all_agar_volume)
summary(model_agar_volume_1)

# check variances
leveneTest(tof ~ treatment, data = all_agar_volume)

#QQ plots
res <- residuals(model_agar_volume_1)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)

# Welch's ANOVA
model_agar_volume_2 <- oneway.test(tof ~ treatment, data = all_agar_volume, var.equal = FALSE)
model_agar_volume_2

# Games-Howell
all_agar_volume_clean <- all_agar_volume %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment),
         tof = as.numeric(tof))

agar_volume_gh_pre <- all_agar_volume_clean %>%
  games_howell_test(tof ~ treatment)
agar_volume_gh_pre
```

``` {r pre-filter plotting}
# pre-filter CLD
agar_volume_gh_pre <- all_agar_volume_clean %>%
  games_howell_test(tof ~ treatment)

p_vec_pre <- setNames(
  ifelse(agar_volume_gh_pre$p.adj < 0.001, 0.0001, agar_volume_gh_pre$p.adj),
  paste(agar_volume_gh_pre$group1, agar_volume_gh_pre$group2, sep = "-")
)

cld_agar_pre <- multcompLetters(p_vec_pre)$Letters
cld_agar_pre

cld_agar_pre <- data.frame(
  treatment = names(cld_agar_pre),
  letter = cld_agar_pre
)

agar_pre_summary <- all_agar_volume %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(tof, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(tof, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(error_bar_top = mean + se) %>%
  left_join(cld_agar_pre, by = "treatment") %>%
  mutate(label_y = case_when(
    treatment == "3 mL agar" ~ 966,
    treatment == "4 mL agar" ~ 1189,
    treatment == "5 mL agar" ~ 1069,
    treatment == "6 mL agar" ~ 1129,
    treatment == "7 mL agar" ~ 712,
    treatment == "8 mL agar" ~ 817
  ))

# pre-filter plot
ggplot(all_agar_volume, aes(x = treatment, y = tof)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "steelblue", color = "black", width = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = agar_pre_summary, aes(x = treatment, y = label_y, label = letter),
            size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "C. elegans Time of Flight by Agar Volume (Pre-Filter)",
    x = "Agar Volume",
    y = "Time of Flight (TOF)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 2000, by = 250),

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )

ggsave("Plots/agar_volume_pre_filter.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
```

#Comparison of Coefficient of Variations Before and After Filtering
``` {r comparison of before and after filtering}
cv_summary <- function(pre_df, post_df, group_var) {
  pre <- pre_df %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      cv_pre = sd(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      n_pre = n(),
      .groups = "drop")
  
  post <- post_df %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      cv_post = sd(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      n_post = n(),
      .groups = "drop")
  
  left_join(pre, post, by = join_by({{ group_var }})) %>%
    mutate(difference = cv_post - cv_pre)
}

compare_cv_6well          <- cv_summary(all_6_well_norm, post_filter_combo_all_6_well_norm, dose)
compare_cv_agar_volume    <- cv_summary(all_agar_volume_norm, post_filter_combo_all_agar_volume_norm, treatment)
compare_cv_liquid_culture <- cv_summary(all_liquid_culture_norm, post_filter_combo_all_liquid_culture_norm, dose)
compare_cv_6cm            <- cv_summary(all_6cm_norm, post_filter_combo_all_6cm_norm, dose)

cv_table <- bind_rows(
  compare_cv_6well %>% mutate(medium = "6 Well", group = as.character(dose)),
  compare_cv_agar_volume %>% mutate(medium = "Agar Volume", group = as.character(treatment)),
  compare_cv_liquid_culture %>% mutate(medium = "Liquid Culture", group = as.character(dose)),
  compare_cv_6cm %>% mutate(medium = "6 cm Plate", group = as.character(dose))
) %>%
  dplyr::select(medium, group, n_pre, n_post, cv_pre, cv_post, difference) %>%
  mutate(
    cv_pre = round(cv_pre, 2),
    cv_post = round(cv_post, 2),
    difference = round(difference, 2)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    "Dosing Medium" = medium,
    "Dose/Treatment" = group,
    "N Pre-Filtering" = n_pre,
    "N Post-Filtering" = n_post,
    "CV Pre-Filtering (%)" = cv_pre,
    "CV Post-Filtering (%)" = cv_post,
    "Difference (%)" = difference
  )

knitr::kable(cv_table)
```

#Comparison of Differing Dosing Mediums
``` {r combining datasets for dosing mediums}
comparison_data <- bind_rows(
  post_filter_combo_all_6_well_norm %>% 
    mutate(medium = "6 well") %>%
    filter(dose %in% c("100 mM", "10 mM", "1 mM", "M9")),
  post_filter_combo_all_liquid_culture_norm %>% 
    mutate(medium = "liquid culture") %>%
    filter(dose %in% c("100 mM", "10 mM", "1 mM", "M9")),
  post_filter_combo_all_6cm_norm %>% 
    mutate(medium = "6 cm") %>%
    filter(dose %in% c("100 mM", "10 mM", "1 mM", "M9"))
) %>%
  mutate(
    medium = factor(medium, levels = c("6 cm", "6 well", "liquid culture")),
    dose = factor(dose, levels = c("100 mM", "10 mM", "1 mM", "M9")),
    id = row_number()
  )

comparison_data %>%
  group_by(medium, dose) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean = mean(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(percent_control, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

``` {r two-way ANOVA for dosing mediums}
# two-way ANOVA
model_1 <- aov(percent_control ~ dose * medium, data = comparison_data)
summary(model_1)

res <- residuals(model_1)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
#Residuals look pretty good actually

leveneTest(percent_control ~ interaction(dose, medium), data = comparison_data)
#Significant for Levene's test
```

``` {r robust two-way ANOVA for dosing mediums}
library(afex)
model_robust_1 <- aov_ez(id = "id",
                         dv = "percent_control",
                         data = comparison_data,
                         between = c("dose", "medium"),
                         white.adjust = TRUE)
summary(model_robust_1)

games_howell_by_dose <- comparison_data %>%
  mutate(dose = droplevels(factor(dose))) %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  games_howell_test(percent_control ~ medium) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 3),
    p.adj = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(p.adj, 4))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(dose, group1, group2, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.adj)

games_howell_by_dose
```
